_decision: Selected and active rows map exactly onto text-sm at medium weight. Weight alone marks a row active — the size does not change, which is what makes this and D-4 a genuine pair.
_scale: Values come from the approved type mapping, not from measuring the component: Tailwind's own theme.css defines --text-base 1rem/1.5rem, --text-sm 0.875rem/1.25rem, --text-xs 0.75rem/1rem, --font-weight-medium 500.
_scope: Reuses L-34-group's anchor: one element, several rows. L-34 asserts the same three properties for a DIFFERENT reason (descender clipping needs line-height >= 20px), and the overlap is deliberate — if they ever disagree, one of the two claims has drifted.
